Student fees and living costs are separate. International 2026/27 cohort increases are capped at 3% annually for the next four years or graduation; this cap is not a 2027 entrant's price.
university-of-british-columbia-bsc-mathe.selection: UBC reviews grades, course choices and the personal profile. High-school applicants to Mathematics BSc Vancouver (Science) must complete the personal profile. Academic prerequisites and English Language Admission Standard depend on qualifications. No universal SAT/ACT rule or department entrance exam was established.
university-of-british-columbia-bsc-mathe.fundingDetail: International Major Entrance Scholarships are competitive, automatically considered for eligible direct-from-school international study-permit applicants applying by admission deadline, and renewable for up to three additional years. Published 2026/27 amounts are CAD 10,000–25,000 annually, not a verified 2027/28 amount. Nominees for International Scholars cannot also be considered for IMES; these merit awards do not cover the full degree cost. Detailed renewal criteria need the offer.
university-of-british-columbia-bsc-mathe.cycle: For Winter Session September 2027–April 2028: admission January 15, 2027, 11:59 p.m. PST. International Scholars applicants must apply for admission and the award by November 15, 2026, 11:59 p.m. PST, and submit documents/English evidence January 31, 2027. Ordinary English-standard documents are due February 15, 2027; out-of-Canada high-school documents March 15, 2027. Canadian/permanent-resident entrance-award admission priority is December 1, 2026.
